summary: Configures stream parameters on `this` and optionally registers it with the sound/stream manager. First validates the mode via sub_5426E0(this, a4, a5), returning -1 on failure. Then stores a5 into this[6] (this+0x18), a2 into this[7] (this+0x1C), and a3 into this[8] (this+0x20). If the low nibble of a5 is nonzero, registers `this` against the manager singleton dword_8B78A0 via sub_53F720, returning -1 if registration fails. Returns 0 on success.

operations.description: If sub_5426E0(this, a4, a5) returns nonzero (mode validation/reconfiguration failure), return -1 without storing or registering.
Store parameter a2 into this[7] (field this+0x1C).
Store parameter a3 into this[8] (field this+0x20).
Store parameter a5 into this[6] (field this+0x18).
If (a5 & 0xF) != 0 (streaming-mode flag set) and sub_53F720(&dword_8B78A0, this, 0) returns nonzero (registration of `this` with the sound/stream manager singleton fails), return -1.

unresolved: The exact meanings of arguments a2/a3/a4 and of the a5 & 0xF mode bits are not evidenced beyond the stored-field writes and the registration guard.
sub_5426E0's contract (what a4/a5 select, what its nonzero return signifies) is not detailed in this packet.
